description: This Dart file defines the 'AppSearchController' class, which manages search-related state and operations for a Flutter application. It handles querying a content repository, caching recent searches, updating UI via ChangeNotifier, and persistence via optional database.

classes.name: AppSearchController
classes.description: Controller for managing search state, performing queries, caching, and persistence in a Flutter app.

methods.name: loadRecent
methods.description: Loads recent searches from cache and optionally from database.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the current search query and clears previous error messages.

methods.name: _persistRecent
methods.description: Persists a search query into cache and database.

methods.name: _runQuery
methods.description: Executes a search query, updates results, manages loading states, and persists recent searches.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles user submission of the current query, triggers search.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes search results from cache, avoiding duplicate refresh efforts.

methods.name: clearRecent
methods.description: Clears recent search history from cache and database.
